prompt.zh: 若把 MOSFET 的通道長度 L 與寬度 W 同時加倍（維持相同的 overdrive 電壓），其本質增益 g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub> 會如何變化？
prompt.en: If we double both the length L and width W of a MOSFET (same overdrive voltage), what happens to its intrinsic gain g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>?

text.zh: 不變
text.en: Unchanged

text.zh: 約變為 2 倍
text.en: Roughly doubles

text.zh: 約變為 1/2
text.en: Roughly halves

text.zh: 約變為 4 倍
text.en: Roughly quadruples

text.zh: 約變為 √2 倍
text.en: Grows by about √2

explanation.zh: W/L 不變且 V<sub>ov</sub> 固定，所以 I<sub>D</sub> 與 g<sub>m</sub> 大致不變；L 加倍使 λ 約減半，r<sub>o</sub> = 1/(λI<sub>D</sub>) 約加倍，因此 g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub> 約加倍。
explanation.en: W/L and V<sub>ov</sub> are unchanged, so I<sub>D</sub> and g<sub>m</sub> stay about the same. Doubling L roughly halves λ, so r<sub>o</sub> = 1/(λI<sub>D</sub>) roughly doubles, and so does g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>.

explanation.en: Two. C<sub>SB</sub> has both terminals grounded and stores no energy. C<sub>GS</sub>, C<sub>GD</sub> and C<sub>DB</sub> form a capacitor loop through ground, so only two of their voltages are independent: two state variables, two poles (C<sub>GD</sub> also adds a zero).

prompt.zh: 從只有 CGS 與 CDB 的電路出發（此時有兩個極點）。再分別加入下列哪些電容，不會增加極點數？（複選）
prompt.en: Start from the circuit with only CGS and CDB (two poles). Which of the following, added on its own, does not increase the number of poles? (Select all that apply.)

text.zh: C<sub>GD</sub>（閘極到汲極）
text.en: C<sub>GD</sub> (gate to drain)

text.zh: C<sub>SB</sub>（源極到地）
text.en: C<sub>SB</sub> (source to ground)

text.zh: 一顆從汲極接到 V<sub>DD</sub> 的電容
text.en: A capacitor from the drain to V<sub>DD</sub>

text.zh: 一顆串聯小電阻後、從汲極接到地的電容
text.en: A capacitor in series with a small resistor, connected from the drain to ground

explanation.zh: C<sub>GD</sub> 與 C<sub>GS</sub>、C<sub>DB</sub> 形成電容迴路，不增加獨立狀態（只多一個零點）；C<sub>SB</sub> 兩端皆為地；汲極到 V<sub>DD</sub>（交流地）的電容與 C<sub>DB</sub> 並聯。只有「電容串電阻」會產生新節點、新增一個極點。
explanation.en: C<sub>GD</sub> closes a capacitor loop with C<sub>GS</sub> and C<sub>DB</sub>, adding no independent state (only a zero). C<sub>SB</sub> sits between two grounds. A drain-to-V<sub>DD</sub> capacitor is in parallel with C<sub>DB</sub> (V<sub>DD</sub> is AC ground). Only the RC branch creates a new node and a new pole.

prompt.zh: 圖中的電路叫什麼？
prompt.en: Name this circuit.

explanation.zh: 三個反相器頭尾相接成環（奇數個反轉），是三級環形振盪器（ring oscillator）。
explanation.en: Three inverters connected head to tail in a loop (an odd number of inversions): a three-stage ring oscillator.

imageAlt.zh: 三級反相器環：每個節點各接一顆對地電容 C<sub>L</sub>
imageAlt.en: Three-inverter loop with a capacitor C<sub>L</sub> from each node to ground

prompt.zh: 若三顆電容都變得任意大，圖中電路會不會停止振盪？
prompt.en: Does the circuit in the figure fail to oscillate if the three capacitors become arbitrarily large?

text.zh: 不會，因為三個節點同等變慢，電路仍振盪、只是頻率降低（約 ∝ 1/C<sub>L</sub>）；振盪條件與 C<sub>L</sub> 無關
text.en: No, because all three nodes slow down equally: it keeps oscillating at a lower frequency (roughly ∝ 1/C<sub>L</sub>); the oscillation condition does not depend on C<sub>L</sub>

text.zh: 不會，因為每個節點都是軌對軌充放電，振盪頻率與 C<sub>L</sub> 無關、維持不變
text.en: No, because every node swings rail to rail, so the oscillation frequency does not depend on C<sub>L</sub> and stays the same

text.zh: 會，因為大電容形成主極點，使相位交越頻率處的迴路增益小於 1
text.en: Yes, because the large capacitors create a dominant pole that pushes the loop gain below unity at the phase-crossover frequency

text.zh: 會，因為維持振盪所需的每級低頻增益隨 C<sub>L</sub> 增大，終究超過反相器的增益
text.en: Yes, because the low-frequency gain each stage needs to sustain oscillation grows with C<sub>L</sub> and eventually exceeds the inverter's gain

explanation.zh: 三顆電容同時加大只會使每級延遲變長、頻率約按 1/C<sub>L</sub> 下降。小訊號看，每級為 −A<sub>0</sub>/(1+s/ω<sub>0</sub>)，ω<sub>0</sub> ∝ 1/C<sub>L</sub>；振盪時每級提供 60° 相移（ω = √3·ω<sub>0</sub>），所需每級增益為 2，與 C<sub>L</sub> 無關。只在單一節點加大電容才會形成主極點而停振。
explanation.en: Scaling all three capacitors only lengthens each stage delay, so the frequency falls roughly as 1/C<sub>L</sub>. In small-signal terms each stage is −A<sub>0</sub>/(1+s/ω<sub>0</sub>) with ω<sub>0</sub> ∝ 1/C<sub>L</sub>; the loop oscillates when each stage gives 60° (ω = √3·ω<sub>0</sub>), which needs a gain of 2 per stage regardless of C<sub>L</sub>. Only loading a single node creates a dominant pole and can stop the oscillation.

imageAlt.zh: 三級反相器環：每個節點各接一顆對地電容 C<sub>L</sub>
imageAlt.en: Three-inverter loop with a capacitor C<sub>L</sub> from each node to ground

prompt.zh: 若圖中三顆電容都加倍，相位雜訊（在相同的頻率偏移 Δf 下）會如何變化？
prompt.en: What happens to the phase noise (at a given offset frequency Δf) if the three capacitors in the figure are doubled?

text.zh: 降低約 6 dB（約 1/4）
text.en: Falls by about 6 dB (a factor of 4)

text.zh: 降低約 3 dB（約 1/2）
text.en: Falls by about 3 dB (a factor of 2)

text.zh: 不變
text.en: Unchanged

text.zh: 增加約 3 dB
text.en: Rises by about 3 dB

text.zh: 增加約 6 dB
text.en: Rises by about 6 dB

explanation.zh: C<sub>L</sub> 加倍使振盪頻率 f<sub>0</sub> 約減半。此環形振盪器由白雜訊造成的相位雜訊正比於 (f<sub>0</sub>/Δf)<sup>2</sup>，其餘因子（元件雜訊電流、偏壓電流、電源電壓）與 C<sub>L</sub> 大致無關，因此在固定 Δf 下降低約 4 倍，即約 6 dB。（若改看固定的相對偏移 Δf/f<sub>0</sub> 則不變。）
explanation.en: Doubling C<sub>L</sub> roughly halves f<sub>0</sub>. The white-noise phase noise of this ring scales as (f<sub>0</sub>/Δf)<sup>2</sup> times factors (device noise currents, bias current, supply) that hardly depend on C<sub>L</sub>, so at a fixed Δf it falls by about 4×, i.e. about 6 dB. (At a fixed relative offset Δf/f<sub>0</sub> it is unchanged.)

imageAlt.zh: 三級反相器環：只有第一級輸出接一顆對地電容 C<sub>L</sub>
imageAlt.en: Three-inverter loop with a single capacitor C<sub>L</sub> from the first stage's output to ground

prompt.zh: 若 C<sub>L</sub> 變得任意大，圖中電路會不會停止振盪？
prompt.en: Does the circuit in the figure fail to oscillate if C<sub>L</sub> becomes arbitrarily large?

text.zh: 會，因為只在一個節點加大電容會形成主極點，使相位交越頻率處的迴路增益掉到 1 以下，不再滿足 Barkhausen 條件
text.en: Yes, because a large capacitor at only one node creates a dominant pole; the loop gain falls below unity at the phase-crossover frequency, so the Barkhausen condition is no longer met

text.zh: 會，因為大電容在直流把該節點短路到地，切斷了直流迴路
text.en: Yes, because the large capacitor shorts the node to ground at dc and breaks the dc loop

text.zh: 不會，與三個節點都加電容時一樣，只是振盪頻率降低
text.en: No, as with a capacitor on all three nodes, it only lowers the oscillation frequency

text.zh: 不會，因為其餘兩個未加載的節點仍能自行維持振盪
text.en: No, because the other two unloaded stages can sustain the oscillation by themselves

explanation.zh: 只在單一節點加大電容會造成不對稱：該節點形成低頻主極點，迴路增益滾降過多；C<sub>L</sub> 夠大時，在相位達 180° 的頻率處迴路增益已小於 1，振盪停止。（時域上也可理解為：被重載的節點太慢，其他節點準靜態地跟隨，有限增益的迴路便停在直流工作點。）
explanation.en: Loading only one node is asymmetric: it creates a low-frequency dominant pole and excessive gain roll-off around the loop. For large enough C<sub>L</sub> the loop gain at the phase-crossover frequency drops below unity and oscillation stops. (In the time domain: the loaded node is so slow that the other nodes follow quasi-statically and the finite-gain loop settles at a dc point.)

imageAlt.zh: 電晶體層級的三級 CMOS 反相器環，無額外負載電容
imageAlt.en: Transistor-level loop of three CMOS inverters with no added load capacitors

prompt.zh: 若把圖中所有 NMOS 與 PMOS 的寬度都加倍，相位雜訊會如何變化？
prompt.en: If we double the widths of the NMOS and PMOS devices in the figure, what happens to the phase noise?

text.zh: 降低約 3 dB：等效於兩個相同的環並聯，訊號同相相加，而不相關的雜訊以功率相加
text.en: Falls by about 3 dB: it is equivalent to two identical rings in parallel, whose signals add coherently while their uncorrelated noise adds in power

text.zh: 降低約 3 dB：較寬的元件產生較小的熱雜訊電流
text.en: Falls by about 3 dB: wider devices produce less thermal noise current

text.zh: 降低約 6 dB：節點電容加倍使振盪頻率減半
text.en: Falls by about 6 dB: the node capacitance doubles, which halves the oscillation frequency

text.zh: 不變：電流與電容同比例加倍，頻率與擺幅都不變
text.en: Unchanged: currents and capacitances double together, so frequency and swing stay the same

text.zh: 增加約 3 dB：較寬元件的雜訊電流功率加倍
text.en: Rises by about 3 dB: the noise current power of the wider devices doubles

explanation.zh: 圖中沒有額外負載電容，節點電容就是元件本身的電容。寬度全加倍時，驅動電流與節點電容同時加倍，振盪頻率大致不變。元件白雜訊電流功率加倍，但訊號電荷/電流的振幅加倍（功率 4 倍），雜訊對訊號比減半，相位雜訊降低約 3 dB，代價是功耗加倍。等效看法：兩個相同的環並聯。（雜訊電流其實隨寬度增加，所以「較寬元件雜訊較小」的理由是錯的；頻率不變，所以不是 6 dB。）
explanation.en: There are no separate load capacitors, so each node's capacitance is the devices' own. Doubling all widths doubles both the drive currents and the node capacitances, so the frequency stays about the same. The white noise current power doubles, but the signal charge and current double in amplitude (4× in power), so the noise-to-signal ratio halves: about 3 dB lower phase noise, at twice the power. Equivalently, two identical rings in parallel. (The noise current actually grows with width, so "wider devices are quieter" is the wrong reason; the frequency does not change, so it is not 6 dB.)

imageAlt.zh: 三級反相器環，三個反相器的電源端接在一起，由該節點看入的電阻為 R<sub>X</sub>
imageAlt.en: Three-inverter loop whose inverters share one supply node; R<sub>X</sub> is the resistance looking into that node

prompt.zh: 求從圖中環形振盪器的電源節點看入的小訊號電阻 R<sub>X</sub>。（f<sub>0</sub>：振盪頻率；C<sub>L</sub>：每個內部節點的等效負載電容；g<sub>mn</sub>、g<sub>mp</sub>：每個反相器 NMOS、PMOS 的轉導。）
prompt.en: Determine the small-signal resistance R<sub>X</sub> seen looking into the supply node of the ring oscillator in the figure. (f<sub>0</sub>: oscillation frequency; C<sub>L</sub>: effective load capacitance at each internal node; g<sub>mn</sub>, g<sub>mp</sub>: transconductances of each inverter's NMOS and PMOS.)

text.zh: R<sub>X</sub> ≈ 1/(3 f<sub>0</sub> C<sub>L</sub>)：每個週期三個節點各從電源抽取約 C<sub>L</sub>V<sub>DD</sub> 的電荷，像三個並聯的切換電容電阻
text.en: R<sub>X</sub> ≈ 1/(3 f<sub>0</sub> C<sub>L</sub>): each period, each of the three nodes draws about C<sub>L</sub>V<sub>DD</sub> from the supply, like three switched-capacitor resistors in parallel

text.zh: R<sub>X</sub> ≈ 3/(f<sub>0</sub> C<sub>L</sub>)：三個節點各相當於一個 1/(f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>) 的切換電容電阻，彼此串聯
text.en: R<sub>X</sub> ≈ 3/(f<sub>0</sub> C<sub>L</sub>): each node acts as a 1/(f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>) switched-capacitor resistor, and the three are in series

text.zh: R<sub>X</sub> ≈ (1/3)(1/g<sub>mn</sub> + 1/g<sub>mp</sub>)：每個反相器偏在跳變點，等效為兩顆二極體接法元件串聯，三個反相器並聯
text.en: R<sub>X</sub> ≈ (1/3)(1/g<sub>mn</sub> + 1/g<sub>mp</sub>): each inverter sits at its trip point and acts as two diode-connected devices in series; the three inverters are in parallel

text.zh: R<sub>X</sub> → ∞：每個反相器總有一顆電晶體截止，電源到地沒有直流路徑
text.en: R<sub>X</sub> → ∞: in each inverter one transistor is always off, so there is no dc path from the supply to ground

explanation.zh: 振盪中的環，其電源電流由負載電容的充放電決定，而非靜態的二極體接法電阻。每週期三個節點各抽約 C<sub>L</sub>V<sub>DD</sub> 的電荷：P = 3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>V<sub>DD</sub><sup>2</sup> = V<sub>DD</sub>I<sub>DD</sub>，故（視 f<sub>0</sub> 固定）dI<sub>DD</sub>/dV<sub>DD</sub> = 3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>，R<sub>X</sub> ≈ 1/(3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>)。（若再考慮 f<sub>0</sub> 隨 V<sub>DD</sub> 上升，可修正為約 1/(6f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>)。）只分析靜態工作點得到的 g<sub>m</sub> 型答案忽略了振盪，Razavi 給 1 分。
explanation.en: In an oscillating ring the supply current is set by charging and discharging the load capacitances, not by static diode-connected resistances. Each period the three nodes each draw about C<sub>L</sub>V<sub>DD</sub>: P = 3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>V<sub>DD</sub><sup>2</sup> = V<sub>DD</sub>I<sub>DD</sub>, so with f<sub>0</sub> fixed, dI<sub>DD</sub>/dV<sub>DD</sub> = 3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub> and R<sub>X</sub> ≈ 1/(3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>). (Including the rise of f<sub>0</sub> with V<sub>DD</sub> refines it to about 1/(6f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>).) The static g<sub>m</sub>-based answer ignores the oscillation; Razavi scores it 1.

imageAlt.en: Three-inverter loop whose inverters share one supply node; R<sub>X</sub> is the resistance looking into that node

prompt.zh: 有人把圖中環形振盪器電源節點看入的小訊號電阻算成 R<sub>X</sub> ≈ (1/3)(1/g<sub>mn</sub> + 1/g<sub>mp</sub>)，理由是每個反相器相當於兩顆二極體接法元件串聯。若電路正在振盪，這個答案會改變嗎？（f<sub>0</sub>：振盪頻率；C<sub>L</sub>：每個節點的負載電容；T<sub>D</sub>：每級延遲；R<sub>eq</sub>：MOS 導通電阻。）
prompt.en: For the ring oscillator in the figure, somebody computes the small-signal resistance seen looking into the supply node as R<sub>X</sub> ≈ (1/3)(1/g<sub>mn</sub> + 1/g<sub>mp</sub>), because each inverter behaves as two diode-connected devices in series. If the circuit oscillates, does this answer change? (f<sub>0</sub>: oscillation frequency; C<sub>L</sub>: load capacitance per node; T<sub>D</sub>: delay per stage; R<sub>eq</sub>: MOS on-resistance.)

text.zh: 會改變機制，但量級差不多：R<sub>X</sub> 改由節點電容充放電決定，R<sub>X</sub> ≈ 1/(3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>) = 2T<sub>D</sub>/C<sub>L</sub>；又 T<sub>D</sub> ≈ R<sub>eq</sub>C<sub>L</sub>，所以 R<sub>X</sub> 仍與導通電阻（約 1/g<sub>m</sub>）同一量級
text.en: Yes, the mechanism changes but not the magnitude much: R<sub>X</sub> is now set by charging the node capacitances, R<sub>X</sub> ≈ 1/(3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>) = 2T<sub>D</sub>/C<sub>L</sub>; since T<sub>D</sub> ≈ R<sub>eq</sub>C<sub>L</sub>, R<sub>X</sub> stays on the order of the on-resistance (about 1/g<sub>m</sub>)

text.zh: 會，R<sub>X</sub> 會大很多：電源到地經電晶體的路徑在大部分時間都是截止的
text.en: Yes, R<sub>X</sub> becomes much higher: the path from V<sub>DD</sub> to ground through the transistors is off most of the time

text.zh: 會，R<sub>X</sub> 改為 1/(3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>)，且因 f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub> 很小，遠大於靜態估計值
text.en: Yes, R<sub>X</sub> becomes 1/(3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>), which is far larger than the static estimate because f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub> is small

text.zh: 不會，平均而言每個反相器仍偏在跳變點附近，小訊號結果照樣成立
text.en: No, on average each inverter still sits near its trip point, so the small-signal result still holds

explanation.zh: 振盪時電源電流來自節點電容的充放電：R<sub>X</sub> ≈ 1/(3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>)。三級環 f<sub>0</sub> = 1/(6T<sub>D</sub>)，故 R<sub>X</sub> ≈ 2T<sub>D</sub>/C<sub>L</sub>；而 T<sub>D</sub> 約為 R<sub>eq</sub>C<sub>L</sub>，所以 R<sub>X</sub> 與 R<sub>eq</sub>（約 1/g<sub>m</sub>）同量級，並沒有因為元件部分時間截止而大很多。Razavi 對「大很多，因為路徑大部分時間截止」的答案給 1 分。
explanation.en: When oscillating, the supply current comes from charging the node capacitances: R<sub>X</sub> ≈ 1/(3f<sub>0</sub>C<sub>L</sub>). For a three-stage ring f<sub>0</sub> = 1/(6T<sub>D</sub>), so R<sub>X</sub> ≈ 2T<sub>D</sub>/C<sub>L</sub>, and with T<sub>D</sub> ≈ R<sub>eq</sub>C<sub>L</sub>, R<sub>X</sub> is on the order of R<sub>eq</sub> (about 1/g<sub>m</sub>): not much higher just because devices are off part of the cycle. text.zh: 改善，而且越寬越好：串聯電阻越小越快
text.en: Improves, and the wider the better: less series resistance is always faster

explanation.zh: 每個閂鎖器中，時脈電晶體與資料電晶體串聯於電源與輸出（X 或 Y）之間。加寬時脈電晶體降低其導通電阻，也就降低對 X、Y 充放電的總電阻；其汲極電容起初相對於節點上其他電容很小，所以延遲下降。超過某個寬度後，增加的電容變得顯著，改善趨緩或反轉：存在最佳寬度。Razavi 指出即使資料元件是瓶頸，速度一開始仍會改善（Gemini 答「變差」得 2 分）。
explanation.en: In each latch a clocked transistor is in series with a data transistor between each supply and the output (X or Y). Widening the clocked transistors lowers their on-resistance and hence the total resistance that charges X and Y; their drain capacitance is at first small compared with the rest at those nodes, so the delay falls. Past some width the added capacitance matters and the gain levels off or reverses: there is an optimum. Razavi notes that even if the data devices are the bottleneck, speed still improves initially (Gemini's "degrades" got 2).

text.en: Nominally yes, but not accurately: the two latches switch half an input period apart (90° at the output frequency), but the delay of Inv3 skews Z, and the two latches see unequal loads (X drives the second latch, Y drives Inv3, whose capacitances see Miller multiplication)

text.zh: 可以，而且是精確的：兩個閂鎖器在相反的時脈邊緣切換、相隔半個輸入週期，因此 Y 或 Z 與 X 正好相差 90°

text.zh: 不能：X 與 Y 互為反相，相差 180°
text.en: No: X and Y are complementary, 180° apart

text.zh: 不能：除二電路只產生單相輸出，需另加多相濾波器才能得到正交訊號
text.en: No: a divide-by-two produces a single phase only; quadrature needs a separate polyphase filter

explanation.zh: 這是 C<sup>2</sup>MOS 除二電路：左閂鎖器以 Z 為輸入產生 X，右閂鎖器以 X 為輸入、在相反相位產生 Y，Inv3 把 Y 反相成 Z。兩閂鎖器相隔半個輸入週期切換，在輸出頻率上就是 90°，所以名義上 X、Y（以及 Z）為正交。但 (1) Inv3 的延遲使 Z 偏斜；(2) 兩個閂鎖器的負載難以相等（X 驅動第二閂鎖器的資料電晶體，Y 驅動 Inv3，其閘汲電容有 Miller 放大），延遲不等，使 X、Y 也不是精確 90°。Razavi 對只答「可以」的答案給 2 分。
explanation.en: This is a C<sup>2</sup>MOS divide-by-two: the left latch takes Z and produces X, the right latch takes X on the opposite phase and produces Y, and Inv3 inverts Y into Z. The latches switch half an input period apart, which is 90° at the output, so X and Y (and Z) are nominally in quadrature. But (1) the delay of Inv3 skews Z, and (2) the two latches see unequal loads (X drives the second latch's data devices, Y drives Inv3, whose gate-drain capacitances see Miller multiplication), so their delays differ and even X and Y are not exactly 90° apart. Razavi scores a plain "yes" 2.

text.zh: 它是繞過 CK 開關與 Inv1 的前饋路徑，提升除頻器速度；同時也讓 Inv1 的輸出在保持期間不會漏電，降低最低可用時脈頻率
text.en: It is a feedforward path that bypasses the CK switch and Inv1, speeding up the divider; it also keeps Inv1's output from leaking away while holding, lowering the minimum usable clock frequency

text.zh: 它是保持器（keeper）：與 Inv1 交叉耦合形成靜態閂鎖器，消除因漏電造成的最低時脈頻率限制

text.zh: 它與後面的反相器形成一個自由振盪的三級環，因此除頻器在任何時脈頻率下都無法正常工作
text.en: It forms a free-running three-stage ring with the following inverters, so the divider cannot work at any clock frequency

explanation.zh: 紅色反相器的輸入取自 CK 開關之前的節點、輸出接 Inv1 的輸出，所以它繞過 CK 開關與 Inv1，是一條前饋路徑，預先驅動 Inv1 的輸出，提升速度。但它沒有時脈控制：CK̄ 開關導通時，紅色反相器、CK̄ 開關與其後兩個反相器構成三次反相的迴路（可自行翻轉的環），而且它會與 Inv1 保持的值互相拉扯。高時脈頻率下半週期太短，影響不大；低時脈頻率時它壓過主路徑、破壞除頻，因此最低可用時脈頻率上升（而非降低）。
explanation.en: The red inverter takes its input from the node before the CK switch and drives Inv1's output, so it bypasses the CK switch and Inv1: a feedforward path that pre-drives Inv1's output and speeds up the divider. But it is unclocked: while the CK̄ switch is on, it, the CK̄ switch and the two following inverters form a loop of three inversions (a ring that can toggle by itself), and it fights the value Inv1 holds. At high clock rates the half-period is too short for this to matter; at low clock rates the branch overpowers the main path and corrupts the division, so the minimum usable clock frequency rises, not falls.

prompt.zh: 針對圖中電路，有人回答：「紅色反相器是保持器（keeper），與 Inv1 形成交叉耦合閂鎖器，消除了因漏電造成的最低時脈頻率要求。」你同意嗎？紅色反相器實際的作用是什麼？
prompt.en: In the figure, somebody answers: "The red inverter acts as a keeper, forming a cross-coupled latch with Inv1. This removes the minimum clock frequency requirement due to leakage." Do you agree with this answer? What is the actual role of the red inverter?

text.zh: 不同意：紅色反相器的輸入並未接到 Inv1 的輸出，所以不是交叉耦合、不是保持器；它是前饋分支，繞過 CK 開關與 Inv1，提升高速表現，但在低時脈頻率時會壓過閂鎖行為，使最低可用時脈頻率上升
text.en: Disagree: the red inverter's input is not tied to Inv1's output, so it is not cross-coupled and not a keeper; it is a feedforward branch that bypasses the CK switch and Inv1, helping high-speed operation, but at low clock rates it overpowers the latch and raises the minimum usable clock frequency

text.zh: 同意：紅色反相器與 Inv1 形成靜態閂鎖器，保持的資料不再因漏電流失，因此沒有最低時脈頻率
text.en: Agree: the red inverter and Inv1 form a static latch, so the held data no longer leaks away and there is no minimum clock frequency

text.zh: 不同意：既然紅色反相器沒有接成保持器迴路，圖應該是畫錯了，此電路無法正常工作
text.en: Disagree: since the red inverter is not connected as a keeper loop, the drawing must be a mistake and the circuit cannot work

text.zh: 部分同意：它確實是保持器，但只能降低、無法完全消除最低時脈頻率
text.en: Partly agree: it is indeed a keeper, but it only lowers the minimum clock frequency rather than removing it

explanation.zh: 紅色反相器的輸入取自 CK 開關之前，並未接到 Inv1 的輸出，因此與 Inv1 不構成交叉耦合，不應視為保持器。它是前饋分支：從較早的節點驅動較晚的節點，繞過部分閂鎖路徑，可改善高速操作；但它沒有時脈控制，低時脈頻率時會壓過預期的動態閂鎖行為，使最低可用時脈頻率上升。
explanation.en: The red inverter's input comes from before the CK switch, not from Inv1's output, so it is not cross-coupled with Inv1 and is not a keeper. It is a feedforward branch: it drives a later node from an earlier signal, bypassing part of the latch path, which helps at high speed; but being unclocked, at low clock rates it overpowers the intended dynamic-latch behavior and raises the minimum usable clock rate.

prompt.zh: 若 R<sub>in</sub> 必須維持 50 Ω，要如何最佳化圖中電路的雜訊指數 NF？（g<sub>m</sub> = g<sub>m1</sub> + g<sub>m2</sub>；r<sub>o</sub> = r<sub>o1</sub> ∥ r<sub>o2</sub>；R<sub>S</sub> = 50 Ω 為訊號源電阻；γ 為通道熱雜訊係數。）
prompt.en: How do we optimize the circuit shown in the figure for the NF if R<sub>in</sub> must remain equal to 50 Ω? (g<sub>m</sub> = g<sub>m1</sub> + g<sub>m2</sub>; r<sub>o</sub> = r<sub>o1</sub> ∥ r<sub>o2</sub>; R<sub>S</sub> = 50 Ω is the source resistance; γ is the channel thermal-noise coefficient.)

text.zh: 利用 R<sub>in</sub> = (R<sub>F</sub> + r<sub>o</sub>)/(1 + g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>)：把 g<sub>m</sub> 提高到 1/R<sub>S</sub> 以上（加大寬度與偏壓電流），同時加大 R<sub>F</sub> 以維持 50 Ω；NF 可降到 1 + γ 以下，趨近 1 + γ/(g<sub>m</sub>R<sub>S</sub>)
text.en: Use R<sub>in</sub> = (R<sub>F</sub> + r<sub>o</sub>)/(1 + g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>): raise g<sub>m</sub> above 1/R<sub>S</sub> (width and bias current) and raise R<sub>F</sub> with it to hold 50 Ω; the noise factor can then fall below 1 + γ, toward 1 + γ/(g<sub>m</sub>R<sub>S</sub>)

text.zh: 因為 R<sub>in</sub> ≈ 1/g<sub>m</sub>，匹配把 g<sub>m</sub> 固定在 1/R<sub>S</sub>；只能加大 R<sub>F</sub> 與 r<sub>o</sub>，讓雜訊因子趨近下限 1 + γ
text.en: Since R<sub>in</sub> ≈ 1/g<sub>m</sub>, matching pins g<sub>m</sub> at 1/R<sub>S</sub>; we can only make R<sub>F</sub> and r<sub>o</sub> large so the noise factor approaches its lower bound of 1 + γ

text.zh: 刻意降低 r<sub>o</sub>（用較短的通道），使 R<sub>in</sub> ≈ R<sub>F</sub>，再選 R<sub>F</sub> = 50 Ω
text.en: Deliberately lower r<sub>o</sub> (shorter channels) so that R<sub>in</sub> ≈ R<sub>F</sub>, then choose R<sub>F</sub> = 50 Ω

text.zh: 保持 g<sub>m</sub> = 1/R<sub>S</sub>，並盡量減小 R<sub>F</sub> 以降低它的熱雜訊
text.en: Keep g<sub>m</sub> = 1/R<sub>S</sub> and make R<sub>F</sub> as small as possible to reduce its thermal noise

explanation.zh: 這是電阻回授（並聯回授）反相器 LNA。若假設 R<sub>in</sub> ≈ 1/g<sub>m</sub>，匹配會把 g<sub>m</sub> 鎖在 1/R<sub>S</sub>，NF 最佳只能趨近 1 + γ，這是 Razavi 給 1 分的答案。考慮有限的 r<sub>o</sub>：R<sub>in</sub> = (R<sub>F</sub> + r<sub>o</sub>)/(1 + g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>)，可選 R<sub>F</sub> = R<sub>S</sub>(1 + g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>) − r<sub>o</sub> 維持 50 Ω，同時讓 g<sub>m</sub> 超過 1/R<sub>S</sub>；雜訊因子隨 g<sub>m</sub> 增大而降到 1 + γ 以下，g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub> 大時趨近 1 + γ/(g<sub>m</sub>R<sub>S</sub>)，代價是功耗與輸入電容。刻意降低 r<sub>o</sub> 並沒有幫助。
explanation.en: This is a resistive-feedback (shunt-feedback) inverter LNA. Assuming R<sub>in</sub> ≈ 1/g<sub>m</sub> pins g<sub>m</sub> at 1/R<sub>S</sub> and the NF can at best approach 1 + γ: the answer Razavi scores 1. With finite r<sub>o</sub>, R<sub>in</sub> = (R<sub>F</sub> + r<sub>o</sub>)/(1 + g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>), so choosing R<sub>F</sub> = R<sub>S</sub>(1 + g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>) − r<sub>o</sub> holds 50 Ω while g<sub>m</sub> exceeds 1/R<sub>S</sub>; the noise factor falls below 1 + γ as g<sub>m</sub> grows, toward 1 + γ/(g<sub>m</sub>R<sub>S</sub>) for large g<sub>m</sub>r<sub>o</sub>, at the cost of power and input capacitance. Lowering r<sub>o</sub> on purpose does not help.

prompt.zh: 求圖中電路的輸入阻抗 R<sub>in</sub>。（A<sub>0</sub>：由 P 到 V<sub>out</sub>、未接 R<sub>F</sub> 負載時的電壓增益大小；忽略通道長度調變。）
prompt.en: Compute the input impedance R<sub>in</sub> of the circuit in the figure. (A<sub>0</sub>: magnitude of the voltage gain from P to V<sub>out</sub> without R<sub>F</sub> loading; neglect channel-length modulation.)

text.zh: R<sub>in</sub> = (R<sub>F</sub> + R<sub>D2</sub>)/(1 + A<sub>0</sub>)，A<sub>0</sub> = ½ g<sub>m1</sub>g<sub>m2,3</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>R<sub>D2</sub>
text.en: R<sub>in</sub> = (R<sub>F</sub> + R<sub>D2</sub>)/(1 + A<sub>0</sub>), A<sub>0</sub> = ½ g<sub>m1</sub>g<sub>m2,3</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>R<sub>D2</sub>

text.zh: R<sub>in</sub> = (R<sub>F</sub> + R<sub>D2</sub>)/(1 + A<sub>0</sub>)，A<sub>0</sub> = g<sub>m1</sub>g<sub>m2,3</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>R<sub>D2</sub>
text.en: R<sub>in</sub> = (R<sub>F</sub> + R<sub>D2</sub>)/(1 + A<sub>0</sub>), A<sub>0</sub> = g<sub>m1</sub>g<sub>m2,3</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>R<sub>D2</sub>

text.zh: R<sub>in</sub> = R<sub>F</sub>/(1 + A<sub>v</sub>)，A<sub>v</sub> = ½ g<sub>m1</sub>g<sub>m2,3</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>(R<sub>D2</sub> ∥ R<sub>F</sub>)
text.en: R<sub>in</sub> = R<sub>F</sub>/(1 + A<sub>v</sub>), A<sub>v</sub> = ½ g<sub>m1</sub>g<sub>m2,3</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>(R<sub>D2</sub> ∥ R<sub>F</sub>)

text.zh: R<sub>in</sub> = R<sub>F</sub>/(1 + g<sub>m1</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>)
text.en: R<sub>in</sub> = R<sub>F</sub>/(1 + g<sub>m1</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>)

explanation.zh: 把 TIA 看成：輸入節點驅動未負載增益為 −A<sub>0</sub>、輸出電阻為 R<sub>D2</sub> 的放大器，R<sub>F</sub> 接在輸入與輸出之間。對 R<sub>F</sub> 套用 Miller 定理（考慮輸出端的 R<sub>D2</sub>）得 R<sub>in</sub> = (R<sub>F</sub> + R<sub>D2</sub>)/(1 + A<sub>0</sub>)。M1 的增益為 g<sub>m1</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>；M2/M3 差動對只有一側輸出到 R<sub>D2</sub>，增益為 ½g<sub>m2,3</sub>R<sub>D2</sub>，故 A<sub>0</sub> = ½g<sub>m1</sub>g<sub>m2,3</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>R<sub>D2</sub>。只寫 R<sub>F</sub>/(1 + A<sub>v</sub>) 並用 R<sub>D2</sub> ∥ R<sub>F</sub> 的負載增益，漏掉了回授路徑輸出端的電阻。
explanation.en: Model the TIA as an input node driving an amplifier of unloaded gain −A<sub>0</sub> and output resistance R<sub>D2</sub>, with R<sub>F</sub> from input to output. Miller's theorem on R<sub>F</sub>, including R<sub>D2</sub> at the output side, gives R<sub>in</sub> = (R<sub>F</sub> + R<sub>D2</sub>)/(1 + A<sub>0</sub>). M1 gives g<sub>m1</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>; the M2/M3 pair delivers only one side to R<sub>D2</sub>, ½g<sub>m2,3</sub>R<sub>D2</sub>, so A<sub>0</sub> = ½g<sub>m1</sub>g<sub>m2,3</sub>R<sub>D1</sub>R<sub>D2</sub>. Writing R<sub>F</sub>/(1 + A<sub>v</sub>) with a loaded gain using R<sub>D2</sub> ∥ R<sub>F</sub> misses the resistance at the output side of the feedback path.

prompt.zh: 若圖中的 LDO 產生頻譜為 S<sub>th</sub> 的熱雜訊，要如何計算 VCO 輸出的相位雜訊？
prompt.en: If the LDO regulator in the figure generates thermal noise with spectrum S<sub>th</sub>, how do we compute the VCO output phase noise?

text.zh: 經由電源推移（supply pushing）：先求 K<sub>push</sub> = ∂f<sub>osc</sub>/∂V<sub>out</sub>，再做 FM→PM 轉換，L(Δf) ≈ K<sub>push</sub><sup>2</sup>S<sub>th</sub>/(2Δf<sup>2</sup>)；因為 V<sub>out</sub> 直接加在變容器上，K<sub>push</sub> 與 K<sub>VCO</sub> 密切相關
text.en: Through supply pushing: find K<sub>push</sub> = ∂f<sub>osc</sub>/∂V<sub>out</sub>, then convert FM to PM: L(Δf) ≈ K<sub>push</sub><sup>2</sup>S<sub>th</sub>/(2Δf<sup>2</sup>); since V<sub>out</sub> appears directly across the varactors, K<sub>push</sub> is closely related to K<sub>VCO</sub>

text.zh: 把 S<sub>th</sub> 視為疊加在輸出擺幅上的加性雜訊：L(Δf) ≈ S<sub>th</sub>/V<sub>amp</sub><sup>2</sup>，與 Δf 無關
text.en: Treat S<sub>th</sub> as additive noise on the output swing: L(Δf) ≈ S<sub>th</sub>/V<sub>amp</sub><sup>2</sup>, independent of Δf

text.zh: LDO 雜訊被尾電流源 I<sub>VCO</sub> 隔離，不會轉成相位雜訊；只需考慮 V<sub>cont</sub> 上的雜訊
text.en: The tail current source I<sub>VCO</sub> isolates the LDO noise, so it does not become phase noise; only noise on V<sub>cont</sub> matters

text.zh: LDO 雜訊只調變振盪振幅（AM），由交叉耦合對的限幅消除，對相位雜訊沒有貢獻
text.en: LDO noise only modulates the oscillation amplitude (AM), which the cross-coupled pair's limiting removes, so it adds no phase noise

explanation.zh: LDO 的輸出雜訊經由電源推移增益調變 VCO 頻率。先（通常以模擬）求 K<sub>push</sub> = df<sub>osc</sub>/dV<sub>out</sub>，把 S<sub>th</sub> 轉為頻率雜訊，再做 FM→PM 轉換，得到 1/Δf<sup>2</sup> 的相位雜訊：L(Δf) ≈ 10 log[K<sub>push</sub><sup>2</sup>S<sub>th</sub>/(2Δf<sup>2</sup>)]。此電路中電源擾動直接出現在變容器上，所以 K<sub>push</sub> 與 K<sub>VCO</sub> 密切相關；降低 K<sub>VCO</sub> 也能降低這項轉換。
explanation.en: The LDO noise modulates the VCO frequency through supply pushing. Find K<sub>push</sub> = df<sub>osc</sub>/dV<sub>out</sub> (usually by simulation), convert S<sub>th</sub> into frequency noise, then FM-to-PM gives a 1/Δf<sup>2</sup> phase noise: L(Δf) ≈ 10 log[K<sub>push</sub><sup>2</sup>S<sub>th</sub>/(2Δf<sup>2</sup>)]. Here the supply perturbation appears directly on the varactors, so K<sub>push</sub> is closely related to K<sub>VCO</sub>; a lower K<sub>VCO</sub> also reduces this conversion.

imageAlt.zh: 交叉耦合 LC 振盪器，尾電流 I<sub>SS</sub>，尾節點 P 接一顆對地電容 C<sub>T</sub>

prompt.zh: 如圖，在尾節點加上 C<sub>T</sub>。相位雜訊會如何變化？
prompt.en: We add C<sub>T</sub> to the tail node, as in the figure. What happens to the phase noise?

text.zh: 非單調：在某個 C<sub>T</sub> 範圍內，交叉耦合對進入類 C 類切換，送入槽路的峰值電流大於 I<sub>SS</sub>，相位雜訊降低；但 C<sub>T</sub> 小時 M1/M2 的閃爍雜訊可能被上轉換，大電流可能把 M1/M2 推入三極管區，C<sub>T</sub> 太大則可能低頻不穩定。C<sub>T</sub> 是需要最佳化的變數
text.en: Non-monotonic: over some range of C<sub>T</sub> the pair switches in a class-C-like mode, delivering peak tank currents larger than I<sub>SS</sub> and lowering the phase noise; but small C<sub>T</sub> can upconvert the flicker noise of M1/M2, the large currents can push M1/M2 into triode, and too large a C<sub>T</sub> can cause low-frequency instability. C<sub>T</sub> is a variable to optimize

text.zh: 大致會降低：C<sub>T</sub> 把 I<sub>SS</sub> 在 2ω<sub>0</sub> 的雜訊旁路到地，並抑制尾節點漣波，避免電晶體進入三極管區
text.en: Generally lowers it: C<sub>T</sub> shunts the I<sub>SS</sub> noise at 2ω<sub>0</sub> to ground and suppresses the tail-node ripple that could push the transistors into triode

text.zh: 單調變差：C<sub>T</sub> 加到槽路上，降低了槽路 Q 值
text.en: Degrades monotonically: C<sub>T</sub> adds to the tank and lowers its Q

text.zh: 沒有影響：對差動訊號而言 P 是虛接地，C<sub>T</sub> 不起作用
text.en: No effect: P is a virtual ground for the differential signal, so C<sub>T</sub> does nothing

explanation.zh: 加 C<sub>T</sub> 對相位雜訊的影響是非單調的。C<sub>T</sub> 小到中等時，尾節點波形改變，若元件不符合理想平方律，M1、M2 的閃爍雜訊可能上轉換成相位雜訊；在某個範圍內，交叉耦合對進入類 C 類切換，峰值槽路電流大於 I<sub>SS</sub>，可降低相位雜訊，但大電流也可能使 M1/M2 進入三極管區；C<sub>T</sub> 過大則可能出現低頻不穩定。Razavi 對「C<sub>T</sub> 濾除尾雜訊、大致降低相位雜訊」的單調結論給 1 分。
explanation.en: Adding C<sub>T</sub> has a non-monotonic effect. For small or moderate C<sub>T</sub> the tail waveform changes and the flicker noise of M1 and M2 can be upconverted unless the devices are ideally square-law; over a certain range the pair enters class-C-like switching with peak tank currents larger than I<sub>SS</sub>, which can lower phase noise, though the large currents can push M1/M2 into triode; too large a C<sub>T</sub> can cause low-frequency instability. explanation.zh: 從槽路諧振 ω<sub>0</sub> = 1/√(LC<sub>node</sub>) 出發，耦合使振盪頻率偏離諧振點 Δω = αω<sub>0</sub>/(2Q)。大訊號、幾乎完全切換時 α ≈ I<sub>1</sub>/I<sub>SS</sub>；小訊號估計 α ≈ g<sub>mc</sub>/g<sub>m1</sub>，即 Δω ≈ (g<sub>mc</sub>/g<sub>m1</sub>)/(2C<sub>node</sub>R<sub>p</sub>)。電路可停在 ω<sub>0</sub> 之上或之下兩個正交模態之一。只寫 g<sub>mc</sub>/(2C<sub>node</sub>) 等於假設 g<sub>m1</sub>R<sub>p</sub> = 1（剛好在起振邊緣），Razavi 給 1 分。
explanation.en: Start from the tank resonance ω<sub>0</sub> = 1/√(LC<sub>node</sub>); the coupling shifts the frequency by Δω = αω<sub>0</sub>/(2Q). With nearly complete switching α ≈ I<sub>1</sub>/I<sub>SS</sub>; in small-signal terms α ≈ g<sub>mc</sub>/g<sub>m1</sub>, i.e. Δω ≈ (g<sub>mc</sub>/g<sub>m1</sub>)/(2C<sub>node</sub>R<sub>p</sub>). The circuit can settle in either quadrature mode, above or below ω<sub>0</sub>. Writing only g<sub>mc</sub>/(2C<sub>node</sub>) assumes g<sub>m1</sub>R<sub>p</sub> = 1 (the edge of oscillation); Razavi scores that 1.
